title: BRIDES DE GALAXY
summary: A planet in the Silky System.
paragraphs: Bridgalaxy is a planet of fun. Time is twisted. It is inhabited by several tribes. Each has a Brides de Gala style as an emblem. These tribes inhabit a planet which is a large, colourful and warm planet.
Guests are open to explore and discover different areas across the evening, traversing the landscape and having unique and uplifting experiences.

gallery.alt: Mirrored disco balls above a vivid pink, orange and blue landscape at Brides de Galaxy, with illuminated steps and a colourful tree.
